scenarios.accuracy_gate: Every published GGUF is compared with official PyTorch using that GGUF's dequantized weights. Explicit upstream CPU Q8 arithmetic retains its raw-logit bound; AUTO CPU RAM Q8 additionally compares all-class sigmoid scores with an independent PyTorch implementation of its activation arithmetic. Original weight-only PyTorch sigmoid bounds remain mandatory for AUTO.

All 50 pinned frames and official label spaces: CPU explicit upstream compatibility arithmetic preserves all-class logits/probabilities and adds no per-class probability, F1 or annotation error. Every backend independently meets original-checkpoint PyTorch cross F1 >= 0.99, probability MAE <= 0.002 and mAP/CP/CR deltas <= 0.01, plus the declared full-class arithmetic reference. Complete AUTO pipeline latency stays within 5 percent of the original upstream on every dataset. GPU reports retain upstream differences as observational metrics without claiming a nonexistent compatibility mode.
Tag2Text captions on all 50 frames: exact and word F1 agreement against the official PyTorch decoder and the same GGUF upstream decoder; complete pipeline latency within 5 percent of upstream.
